name: POST /api/leadflow/meetings/:id/cancel - cancel, and silence every pending reminder
description:
Cancels the meeting and SUPPRESSES EVERY PENDING REMINDER (327ca5f6-1d99-4b2c-9e2a-218250f64f45#AC4). A cancelled meeting whose 2-hour reminder still fires sends the customer a link to a meeting that is not happening, which is worse than sending nothing at all.

A REASON IS REQUIRED, because a cancellation is a commitment being withdrawn and the record is what a later reader has to judge it by.

SUPPRESSED RATHER THAN DELETED. The reminder rows stay with their suppression reason, so "did we tell them" remains answerable after the fact - a deleted row cannot answer it. WHY `reason` CARRIES NO fieldEnums. The review reads it as enum-backed; it is not. A cancellation reason is free prose written by whoever withdrew the commitment, and a picklist would produce the same six sentences forever while losing the one that mattered. A false enum in the API docs would tell QA to expect values the handler never constrains. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Cancelling an unknown meeting is refused
NEGATIVE: a cancellation with no reason is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: reason is required to cancel a meeting
Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
